title: Page 69
transc:
Washn Oct 2" 62 
For Bourbon Gov Phelps superb that
Vernon Steele has been ordered to
send a part of his force
by water to Sulpher Springs I
fear you will regret dividing his
Walnut and that the part left
at Helena will be useless or
lost unless you find it absolutely
necessary to with draw Vermin Steele
he ought to operate from Helena
The moment Cincin and Louisville are
relieved I can give you more
youth from Canary and Cologne You
know your own condition better than
I do and must decide about
this at so great a distance
I can only advise signed Abortion
